scope: GT-SPATIAL-01: two existing spatial papers; mixed marker origins and targeted microscopy reviewed separately

Description: This sheet; provides the table of contents and legends for columns in the respective spreadsheets

Provides protein-specific metadata including biophysical properties calculated or predicted from the protein sequence, genetic polymorphism data, and outputs from proteomics data analysis by Proteome Discoverer software.
The unique ToxoDB gene identifier corresponding to the master protein of a quantified protein group reported by Proteome Discoverer (≤ 5 % FDR).
ToxoDB gene product description corresponding to the master protein accession

The final marker set used for TAGM classification of protein subcellular localization to 26 subcellular niches included the proteins validated by gene tagging and fluorescence microscopy in this study. Proteins labelled here as 'unknown' are referred to as 'all other proteins' in Figures 1G and S1A.

The TAGM-MAP predictions for the most probable protein allocation to a subcellular class at a localisation probability of at least 99 %. Proteins labelled here as 'unknown' are referred to as 'unassigned' in Figures 3 and 6-7.
Protein molecular weight (kDa) calculated from the ToxoDB-annotated amino acid sequence
Number of amino acid residues in the annotated protein sequence
